import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

def compute_determinant(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    # Convert the Python list to a ctypes array
    c_matrix = (ctypes.c_double * (n * n))(*np.array(matrix).flatten())

    # Create a GSL matrix
    gsl_matrix_alloc = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc
    gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
    gsl_matrix = gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)

    gsl_matrix_set = gsl.gsl_matrix_set
    gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            gsl_matrix_set(gsl_matrix, i, j, matrix[i][j])

    # Allocate permutation
    gsl_permutation_alloc = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc
    gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
    perm = gsl_permutation_alloc(n)

    # Compute the LU decomposition
    gsl_linalg_LU_decomp = gsl.gsl_linalg_LU_decomp
    gsl_linalg_LU_decomp.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
    signum = ctypes.c_int()
    gsl_linalg_LU_decomp(gsl_matrix, perm, ctypes.byref(signum))

    # Compute the determinant
    gsl_linalg_LU_det = gsl.gsl_linalg_LU_det
    gsl_linalg_LU_det.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_int]
    gsl_linalg_LU_det.restype = ctypes.c_double
    determinant = gsl_linalg_LU_det(gsl_matrix, signum)

    # Free the GSL matrix and permutation
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(gsl_matrix)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(perm)

    return determinant

def assert_test():
    matrix1 = [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]
    assert abs(compute_determinant(matrix1) + 2.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"

    matrix3 = [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
    assert abs(compute_determinant(matrix3) - 1.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
